claims.text: Equimolar WTaTiVZr qualifies as a multi-principal-element high-entropy alloy.
The equimolar WTaTiVZr alloy forms a single-phase BCC solid solution.
The WTaTiVZr alloy has significant intrinsic lattice distortion caused by its equimolar multi-element composition.
The pure-tungsten baseline has a relatively ordered, coarse-grained microstructure with limited intrinsic lattice strain.
Lattice distortion in WTaTiVZr lowers the energy barriers for dislocation motion and cross-slip.
Lattice distortion in WTaTiVZr facilitates activation of multiple slip systems.
Enhanced cross-slip in WTaTiVZr promotes dynamic recovery and rearrangement into lower-energy dislocation networks at high temperature.
Enhanced dislocation activity and dynamic recovery produce a more uniform plastic-strain distribution in WTaTiVZr.
A more uniform strain distribution delays localized strain concentration and crack initiation in WTaTiVZr.
Pure tungsten's more ordered lattice limits dynamic recovery relative to WTaTiVZr.
Under identical loading at 800–1000 °C, WTaTiVZr will exhibit a higher density of active dislocation sources than pure tungsten.
Under identical loading at 800–1000 °C, WTaTiVZr will exhibit more frequent dislocation cross-slip than pure tungsten.
Under identical loading at 800–1000 °C, WTaTiVZr will show more evidence of dynamic recovery than pure tungsten.
WТаTiVZr will exhibit a more uniform plastic-strain distribution than pure tungsten under the specified loading.
WTaTiVZr will exhibit greater total elongation or plastic strain than pure tungsten under the specified loading.
WTaTiVZr will exhibit greater toughness than pure tungsten under the specified loading.
WTaTiVZr will initiate cracks later than pure tungsten under the specified loading.
Temperatures of 800–1000 °C are representative of sustained plasma-facing-component service.
Applying identical stress profiles to WTaTiVZr and pure tungsten isolates lattice distortion as the cause of their different dislocation behavior.
The proposed mechanism applies only while WTaTiVZr remains single-phase BCC without substantial grain coarsening or phase transformation.
